title: Check any fix: frozen live eval
protocol: Frozen before any live run of these items. Each item is sent once per run to POST /api/check-fix with live=true on a local server (port 3510, Nemotron-3_5-Lightning plan, nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b judge). No retries. If the prompts change after a run, the whole list is rerun and every run is reported. Expected categories were written before running; 'expected' lists every status counted as a pass.

frozenList.fix: Tighten discount combination settings to stop staff POS discounts stacking
frozenList.rationale: Shopify documents that custom discounts applied manually in POS or draft orders always apply regardless of combination settings, so the fix does not stop them.

frozenList.fix: Shorten the return window from 30 to 14 days
frozenList.rationale: Return windows are merchant-set in Shopify return rules; the help center should show the setting exists (supported) or not settle it (insufficient). Contradicted would be wrong.

frozenList.fix: Switch lightweight packages to USPS Ground Advantage
frozenList.rationale: USPS Ground Advantage is the current USPS ground service for lightweight packages; usps.com should support it or at least not contradict it.

frozenList.fix: Use UPS SurePost for residential deliveries
frozenList.rationale: UPS SurePost was rebranded as UPS Ground Saver in 2024; ups.com may show the change (contradicted) or not settle it. Supported only counts as a pass if quotes show SurePost is currently offered, which we do not expect.

frozenList.fix: Require a minimum purchase amount on our free shipping discount code
frozenList.rationale: Shopify free shipping discounts support minimum purchase requirements.

frozenList.fix: Turn on individual use only so coupons cannot be combined with other coupons
frozenList.rationale: WooCommerce coupon usage restrictions include 'Individual use only', which prevents use with other coupons.

frozenList.fix: Raise prices on our slowest selling products to protect margin
frozenList.rationale: Pricing strategy is not a platform or carrier policy question; the plan should mark topic 'other' and the route should hold before any search.
